# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux architecture support changes**

## Highlights

The upcoming release drops packaged Linux x86 native assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries are removed. Retarget applications that depend on those assets to a supported Linux architecture, such as x64 or ARM64, before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
